GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2012-01-19T17:36:24Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: overrideMimeType not supported in IE9
Description: While attempting to load a JSON model, I ran into a scripting error in IE.  It appears they have not implemented XMLHttpRequest.overrideMimeType().  I am able to get around the error using:

``` javascript
f.open("GET",c,!0);  if (f.overrideMimeType)f.overrideMimeType("text/plain; charset=x-user-defined");  f.setRequestHeader("Content-Type","text/plain");
```

instead of

``` javascript
f.open("GET",c,!0);  f.overrideMimeType("text/plain; charset=x-user-defined");   f.setRequestHeader("Content-Type","text/plain");
```

I'm not certain if this introduces any new issues with other browsers, but am now able to view a model in IE 9.
